Fractal Space walkthrough

Welcome to our complete guide for Fractal Space. This walkthrough covers every level, all collectibles and the secret achievements you can unlock on a first playthrough.

Level 1 is a short tutorial: use the left stick to move your ship and press the trigger to fire. Collect the blue crystals to refill your shield and avoid the red turrets that guard the first corridor.

Level 2, the Tunnel, is a straight run through a rotating tube. Keep to the center of the screen, dodge the incoming asteroids and save your bombs for the mini boss waiting at the end of the tunnel; three hits to the core are enough to finish it.

The final boss has three phases. In phase one, stay behind the pillars while it charges its cannon. In phase two it spawns drones: shoot them for health pickups. In phase three, use your charged weapon whenever the weak point glows, and you will win the game.

Achievements: complete every level without losing a life to earn the Perfect Pilot trophy, and collect all 120 crystals to unlock the hidden ending of the game.
